# UX & State Requirements Quality Checklist: Reset View Button

**Purpose**: Validate the quality (clarity, completeness, consistency, measurability) of the Reset view requirements, focused on UX/accessibility and start-view/state-preservation. Standard depth, for PR reviewers.
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the button's position on the map specified precisely enough (which corner/relative to other controls), rather than only "with the other map controls"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified whether the button shows a visible text label, an icon, or both, given FR-008 allows "a tooltip or visible label"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the button's visual states (hover, focus, active, pressed)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK004 Is the exact start-up zoom used for the located view stated in the spec rather than only "the start-up zoom"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the button's behaviour while the map has not finished loading? [Gap, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "settles on at start-up" defined with a clear moment or trigger (e.g., first location fix vs. a time limit)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK007 Is "does not overlap" quantified (minimum spacing or breakpoints) for the panel, zoom controls and attribution? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK008 Is "narrow mobile screens" defined with a width threshold? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK009 Is "the map still ends up at the starting view" defined for an in-flight animation, including whether the animation is interrupted or completed first? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do the "Location arrives late" edge case and FR-005 ("MUST NOT change after start-up") agree on whether the starting view can change once after location arrives? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK011 Is the status message treatment consistent between FR-006 (unchanged) and the location-denied status shown at start-up? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK012 Is the existing top-left overlap of the search panel and zoom controls reconciled with FR-002's "without overlapping" wording? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Is "same centre and zoom" defined with a tolerance (exact equality vs. rounding)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §SC-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK014 Is the 1-second budget in SC-002 measured from a defined start and end event? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK015 Can SC-003 ("under 5 seconds without instructions") be objectively verified, and is the test population defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK016 Is "announced correctly by a screen reader" tied to specific assistive technologies or criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the case where the location fix arrives after the user has already moved the map manually? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a location that arrives after a search has already moved the map (e.g., selecting a place when no position exists)? [Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK019 Is behaviour specified when the user's location changes country or is very inaccurate at start-up? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK020 Are open popups (e.g., the destination popup) addressed when the view resets? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for touch interactions such as accidental double taps on the button? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Accessibility & Non-Functional

- [x] CHK022 Is the minimum touch target size for the button specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK023 Are colour contrast and focus indicator visibility requirements quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK024 Is the keyboard tab order position of the button relative to the panel and other controls specified? [Gap, Spec User Story 2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK025 Is it specified whether a screen reader is told that the view changed after activation? [Gap, Spec User Story 2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK026 Is the language/localisation expectation for the label documented beyond "English"? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Is the assumption that the starting view is session-only validated against users who reload and expect a persistent start? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK028 Is the "default view" (Paris) documented in the spec as a defined value rather than only "the app's fixed default view"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK029 Is the traceability between acceptance scenarios and functional requirements (e.g., FR-009 has no matching scenario) established? [Traceability, Spec §FR-009] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
